research_summary_run_id: NONE (Static in-memory data from frozen 2026-09-21 research session)
selection_rule: Unconditional return of raw_cats list in MRIReadModel.get_categories()
why_selected_currently: get_categories() contained no database query or evidence inspection; it unconditionally returned a frozen stub created during Phase A/B before commercial materialization was active.
fallback_mechanism: None. It was the sole implementation in get_categories().
findings: RESEARCH_SUMMARY_NOT_MATERIALIZED is a hardcoded literal assigned to each entry in raw_cats.
TopN values ('top30_count', etc.) are similarly hardcoded as 'N/A (NOT MATERIALIZED)'.
Even after MRI materializes live categories and publications into SQLite (mri_categories, mri_publication_categories, mri_publications), get_categories() bypassed SQLite entirely.
The read model needs to dynamically query SQLite tables (mri_categories, mri_publication_categories, mri_publications) for the active/latest commercial run.
